name: Great Assistant (Virtual Assistant)
desc:
Virtual Assistant (Law Firm Support) | $30.00/hr | Email, Calendar, and Billing Support, Minimal Phone
Company: The Lipp Law Firm, PC (staffed through Great Assistant, a VA matching service)
Industry: Legal Services | Virtual Executive/Administrative Support
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 This role has you supporting the owner of a Washington DC/Maryland/Virginia employment and business law firm directly, managing her email inbox, calendar, and daily administrative workflow. You're the person keeping the behind-the-scenes operations organized: coordinating appointments, checking in each morning to review priorities, and following through on tasks without needing repeated instructions.
A meaningful part of the job is billing and financial admin, entering contractor time and creating invoices in PracticePanther, processing client payments through LawPay, and uploading bank statements for the bookkeeper. You'll also handle some client-facing work, returning calls to potential clients, responding to inquiries, and preparing thank-you letters to referral partners. This is a genuinely trusted, close-working role, you're managing private legal, client, and financial information, so discretion and good judgment matter as much as task execution.
Because this is matched through Great Assistant (a company that pairs assistants with entrepreneurs and business owners), you'd be working specifically and directly for Katie Lipp and her operations manager, not a general pool of rotating clients.
assessment: Likely. Great Assistant commonly utilizes screening questionnaires, skills evaluations, and multiple interview stages to assess organization, communication, and attention to detail.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: Not specified in posting.
 Required Experience: Not specified by years, though previous law firm or professional services office experience is called out as a plus.

Preferred Experience: Experience with Google Workspace, Monday.com, Adobe, ChatGPT, Dropbox, PracticePanther, and LawPay.
 Required Skills:
Reliable, consistent follow-through without needing repeated instructions
Strong spelling, grammar, and written communication
Comfort handling numbers, billing, invoices, and payments
Strong listening and detailed note-taking
Good judgment and discretion with private legal, client, and financial information
Tech-savvy with the ability to quickly learn new tools and software
Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone with strong administrative or executive assistant experience who is highly organized and detail-oriented
Participants who write well and communicate clearly and professionally in writing
Anyone comfortable managing billing and invoicing tasks alongside calendar and inbox management
People who want a genuine long-term role (the posting specifically seeks a 3+ year commitment) with a real, ongoing working relationship rather than rotating projects
Not a Good Fit for:
Participants who need full-time hours or W-2 employee benefits, this is a 15-20 hour/week, 1099 contractor position with no benefits, and self-employment taxes are the contractor's own responsibility
Someone outside Eastern or Central time zones, these are preferred given required morning ET availability
Anyone uncomfortable handling sensitive legal and financial information with discretion
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Virtual assistant
Executive support
Calendar and inbox management
Legal billing
PracticePanther
LawPay
Invoice processing
Client communication
Administrative support
Confidentiality and discretion
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you.
If assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen.
If phone screen passes you can expect the final interview.
 Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3-15 days on average.
Important note specific to this posting: applicants must not contact Katie Lipp or The Lipp Law Firm directly, doing so will disqualify the application. All communication should go through Great Assistant.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell me about your experience managing someone else's calendar, inbox, or daily priorities.
How do you handle billing, invoicing, or payment processing tasks accurately?
Describe a time you had to use discretion with sensitive or confidential information.
How do you stay reliable and follow through on tasks without needing repeated reminders?
What's your experience with tools like PracticePanther, LawPay, or similar practice management software, if any?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $30.00/hr USD.
Shift: Remote, 1099 contractor. 15-20 hours/week, with possibility of additional hours. Flexible Monday-Friday, some morning ET availability required. ET or CT time zone residency preferred.
Benefits: None stated, this is a 1099 independent contractor role, not W-2 employment, so no employer-provided benefits, and the contractor is responsible for their own taxes.
Equipment Provided: Not specified in posting.
Felony Friendly?: Not stated in posting or found in outside research specific to Great Assistant. The posting confirms a background check is required ("You must be able to pass a background check"), and given this role involves handling private legal and financial client information at a law firm, expect a thorough review. Confirm directly.
Drug Test: Not stated in posting.
Notes: This is a 1099 contractor role, not traditional employment, no benefits, and the contractor handles their own tax withholding, worth explaining clearly to a participant who may not have worked as a contractor before. Strong pay rate ($30/hr) for part-time hours (15-20/week), which could work well as a genuine second income stream or a flexible primary role for the right person. The "do not contact the firm directly" instruction is unusual and important, make sure a participant understands this is a hard rule, not just a suggestion.
Career Pathway: Virtual Assistant (Contract) → Senior Virtual Assistant → Operations Coordinator → Practice/Operations Manager → Director of Operations
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
